name: s135-commit-gate-stale-record-never-blocks
notes: TAN-7040. The file changed after its check, so its passing record no longer covers the content being committed. The gate says so and still allows the commit: re-running the check costs seconds, and re-verification is stop-gate.sh's job, with a budget (ADR-026). A commit door that re-runs typechecks is a commit door people route around. The wording has to match: a stale record is not a failed check, so the message must not say a check did not pass.
